d:
One person is dead and at least eight others are injured after a shooting Saturday night near the Magic City Classic in Birmingham, Alabama, authorities said.
The Magic City Classic is the largest historically Black college and university football game in the United States.
Officers responded to the 400 block of Graymont Avenue around 7:50 p.m. and suspended all tailgating in the area, according to the Birmingham Police Department.
Investigators said multiple firearms were recovered at the scene, and one person was detained and taken to police headquarters for questioning.
